title: [4.6.x] `AnimationTree` throwing `set_parameter: Condition "!process_state->tree->property_parent_map.has(node_state.base_path)" is true.` error repeatedly
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 
- v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]
- v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

Not reproducible in
- v4.7.beta1.official [1c8cc9e7e]
- v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9174) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.91 GiB memory

### Issue description

Every time the character starts moving in a difference direction it throws the following error in the console
```
E 0:00:01:561   set_parameter: Condition "!process_state->tree->property_parent_map.has(node_state.base_path)" is true.
  <C++ Source>  scene/animation/animation_tree.cpp:91 @ set_parameter()
```
This doesn't seem to break any functionality as the animations can still work so I have no idea why the error is happening

This issue seems to have been reported previously with slightly difference context #103253 and was closed and reported as fixed but it seems to still occur for me.

### Steps to reproduce

`AnimationTree` with a `CharacterBody2D` node animating a `Sprite2D` via an `AnimationNodeStateMachine` that switches between two state machines via `advance_expression` being set to `velocity`

I have the following code in the script attached to the `CharacterBody2D` in a function run in its physics process
```gdscript
player_animation_tree.set("parameters/Idle/blend_position", last_facing_direction)
player_animation_tree.set("parameters/Walk/blend_position", last_facing_direction)
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godotbug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27251918/godotbug.zip)
